name: Chinese Rice Salad
description: A flavorful salad made with Minute Rice, frozen peas, chopped celery, and a savory dressing, optionally garnished with chow mein noodles and shrimp.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine cooked rice, frozen peas, chopped celery, and onion in a large bowl.
In a separate bowl, mix together the dressing ingredients (oil, soy sauce, malt vinegar, curry powder, salt, and sugar).
Pour the dressing over the rice mixture and toss to combine.
Garnish with chow mein noodles and/or add drained shrimp if desired.

keywords: Chinese rice salad, savory salad, Minute Rice

_similar.name: Sauerkraut Salad
_similar.description: A tangy and crunchy salad featuring sauerkraut, chopped vegetables, and a sweet-and-sour dressing that keeps well in the refrigerator.
recipeIngredient: 1 (28 oz) jar or can sauerkraut, drained

recipeInstructions.text: Heat the vinegar, sugar, and salt in a saucepan until boiling.
Let the dressing cool to room temperature.
In a large bowl, combine the drained sauerkraut, chopped celery, onion, red pepper, and green pepper.
Pour the cooled dressing over the salad and toss to coat.
Store in a sealed container in the refrigerator for up to 2-3 weeks.

_similar.keywords: sauerkraut salad, tangy salad, make-ahead salad

_similar.name: Tossed Berry-Mandarin Salad
_similar.description: A refreshing mixed greens salad with strawberries, mandarin oranges, sweet onion, and bacon, topped with a homemade honey-cider dressing.
recipeIngredient: 1 medium sweet onion, sliced and separated into rings

recipeInstructions.text: In a microwave-safe bowl, combine sugar, cider vinegar, honey, lemon juice, paprika, mustard, grated onion, celery seed, and salt.
Microwave uncovered on high for 1½ to 2 minutes, stirring until the sugar is dissolved.
Whisk in vegetable oil until well combined. Refrigerate until chilled.
In a large serving bowl, combine the mixed greens, sliced strawberries, mandarin oranges, sweet onion rings, toasted almonds, and crumbled bacon.
Drizzle the chilled dressing over the salad and gently toss to coat.

_similar.keywords: fruit salad, mixed greens, strawberry, mandarin orange, bacon

_similar.name: Mandarin Orange Salad
_similar.description: A classic spinach and lettuce salad with mandarin oranges and toasted almonds, dressed with a sweet and tangy homemade vinaigrette.

recipeInstructions.text: Wash and clean the romaine lettuce, red tip lettuce, and spinach. Dry thoroughly and rip into bite-sized pieces.
In a saucepan, combine sugar, vinegar, mustard, and salt. Bring to a boil, then allow to cool.
Once cooled, blend the dressing mixture in a blender until smooth.
Pour the dressing over the prepared lettuce mixture about 10 minutes before serving.
Just before serving, add the drained mandarin oranges and toasted slivered almonds.

_similar.keywords: mandarin orange salad, spinach salad, homemade dressing

_similar.name: Sliced Bean Salad
_similar.description: A tangy and sweet pickled bean salad made with green or yellow beans, perfect for serving with onion and cream.

recipeInstructions.text: Slice the beans and cook until tender enough to pierce with a fork.
Drain the cooked beans and pack them into jars.
In a saucepan, bring the sugar, water, vinegar, and salt to a boil to make the syrup.
Pour the hot syrup over the beans in the jars.
To serve, pour off the liquid and add chopped onion and cream.

_similar.keywords: pickled bean salad, sweet and tangy, preserved beans

_similar.name: Romaine Salad with Orange
_similar.description: A refreshing salad featuring romaine lettuce, oranges, and red onion with a light vinaigrette dressing.
recipeIngredient: ¼ cup red wine vinegar or cider vinegar

recipeInstructions.text: In a large bowl, combine the torn romaine lettuce, drained mandarin oranges, and thinly sliced red onion.
In a separate bowl, combine the red wine vinegar, oil, minced parsley, garlic, salt, and pepper to make the dressing.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to coat.
Serve immediately.

_similar.keywords: romaine salad, orange salad, vinaigrette dressing
